title: XR Image Controls & Quiet Gestures · v0.9.1
changes: Fixed source image EXTRACT, ··· and × controls by giving button actions precedence over incidental controller rotation during press/release.
Precise XR button hit regions use the actual image card canvas dimensions, including portrait and landscape captures.
Removed flashing head-locked gesture notifications; gestures now produce short, rate-limited speech and a small label beside the mascot.
No change to the real microphone listening indicator, data store, model limits, or release watcher.
Regression tests exercise XR hit-region mapping, latched button actions and rotated hand/controller input without paid calls.
